Episode 3 (Original 86) story overview

Spoiler-free overview

Two connected crises bring diplomacy closer to collapse: Saruca is badly wounded in Constantinople, and Ottoman envoys face detention in Tabriz. Sultan Muhammad Fateh Episode 86 with Urdu subtitles follows the danger created by the previous episode’s negotiations.

Episode numbering help

What happens in Episode 3 (Original 86)?

Spoiler notice: plot details from published synopses.

  1. Saruca is seriously wounded

    An attack in Constantinople triggers an investigation and raises tensions between the states.

  2. Savcu faces an accusation

    Savcu is detained in connection with the attack. Detention does not establish that he is the culprit.

  3. The envoys are trapped

    Tahrani’s manoeuvre endangers Gedik Ahmed, Bali Bey and the raiders in Tabriz, where they face judgment.

These details come from published synopses, not a complete watched recap. The sources do not establish every scene or the ending.

Previous episode context and key characters

The envoy mission begins in Episode 85. Episode 86 shows how an attack in the Ottoman capital and danger in Tabriz can undermine that mission at the same time.

Saruca
The wounded official whose attack sparks the investigation.
Savcu
Detained under suspicion.
Gedik Ahmed & Bali Bey
Members of the threatened Ottoman party in Tabriz.

Episode 3 (Original 86): frequently asked questions

Is Season 4 Episode 3 the same as Episode 86?+

Yes. Season 4 Episode 3 maps to overall Turkish Episode 86, also written Bölüm 86. A dubbed release can use a different cut or numbering.

What is the release date for Episode 86?+

The original Turkish broadcast date is 29 September 2026. That date does not establish when the Urdu-subtitled edition was uploaded.

Where can I watch Episode 86 with Urdu subtitles for free?+

Great Nation is our first choice for free viewing with notifications. Open Episode 3 / Bolum 86 and select Urdu Subtitles. The publisher has verified this release.

How do I choose the correct Urdu version?+

Open Episode 3 / Bolum 86 and select Urdu Subtitles. Savcu’s detention is an accusation in the synopsis, so a recap should not label him the confirmed attacker.

Does Episode 86’s synopsis prove who attacked Saruca?+

No. It identifies Savcu’s detention and the surrounding suspicion. It does not prove his guilt, confirm Saruca’s eventual recovery, or provide the complete resolution in Tabriz.
